SELECT t.transaction_num, m.name AS member_name, mc.merchant_name AS merchant_name, t.amount_used, t.payment_date,
CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_TransactionHistory cancel WHERE cancel.original_transaction_num = t.transaction_num) THEN 'R' ELSE t.status END AS status, t.start_date, t.end_date FROM T_TransactionHistory t JOIN T_Member m ON t.member_code = m.member_code JOIN T_Merchant mc ON t.merchant_code = mc.merchant_code WHERE t.member_code = #{memberCode}
AND t.status != 'R'
AND ( (#{status} = 'R' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_TransactionHistory cancel WHERE cancel.original_transaction_num = t.transaction_num)) OR (#{status} != 'R' AND t.status = #{status} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_TransactionHistory cancel WHERE cancel.original_transaction_num = t.transaction_num)) )
ORDER BY t.payment_date DESC, t.transaction_num DESC
